sloka: सभाज्य मुदिता रामम् स अगस्त्या इदम् अब्रुवन् ।एतत् अर्थम् महातेजा महेन्द्रः पाक शासनः ॥३-३०-३४॥
transliteration: sabhājya muditā rāmam sa agastyā idam abruvan ।etat artham mahātejā mahendraḥ pāka śāsanaḥ ॥3-30-34॥

translations.english: 'In a little more than half a moment of this great war Rama had accomplished the terrific task of killing with sharp darts fourteen thousand demons, led by Khara and Dusana.
